component.name: AI Booster
component.summary: VPN client for the AI Booster network

description.p: The Linux desktop client for AI Booster. It manages subscriptions and profiles, selects servers, shows live traffic and logs, and points the desktop's proxy settings at the local tunnel.

This package is the user interface only. The tunnelling engine is a separate program that this client launches and talks to over loopback sockets; it is not linked into the application and is distributed separately.
